name: Inference Station
stats_concepts: p-values, CIs, Type I/II error, effect size, power
briefing: Is the rise in women astronauts more than chance? First decide what "chance" means, and what a p-value can tell you about a log that already includes almost everyone who has flown.

log.title: Entry 8: Hypotheses filed
log.text: Null and alternative hypotheses written for the Crew Log. Because the log is close to a complete population, a test here asks whether a pattern is bigger than the variation a random process would produce, not whether it exists out there somewhere.
